question: A research agent runs a loop of 20 steps. Each step produces 400 visible output tokens. A reasoning model additionally spends 3000 thinking tokens per step, and its price per token is 4 times that of the standard model. By what factor does the total output cost of the run grow compared to running every step on the standard model? Give a single number.
